description: Ministry of Justice - Order made to authorize the incorporation of the Trustees of the Maviddapuram Pon Trust
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an Order made under Section 114 of the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87), which is a legal/regulatory instrument. It authorizes the incorporation of trustees into a body corporate, granting them legal status and powers to manage trust property and engage in legal proceedings. This falls squarely under legal framework and regulatory matters, specifically dealing with statutory instruments and legal incorporation procedures under existing legislation.
